tools.name: set_skill_domain_category
tools.description: Set the domainCategory axis on an existing skill, matched by (name, team) — a metadata-only patch that touches ONLY the domainCategory field. Never reads or writes vrContent / vrContentHash / vrContentVersion, so it never drifts the skill's content SHA (unlike a full upsert_skill roundtrip, which requires `content` and would force a body rewrite just to set this one axis). Throws if no skill matches (name, team).

tools.name: get_skill_content
tools.description: Fetch the VR-hosted canonical SKILL.md body for a skill. Returns content, sha256 hash, semver version, and last sync timestamp. Also returns testContent, testContentHash, and testContentVersion if a test corpus has been stored alongside the canonical body. Returns null fields if the skill has not been hosted in VR yet.

tools.name: upsert_skill_content
tools.description: Set or update the canonical SKILL.md body in VantageRegistry. Computes sha256; if content is unchanged from the stored version the call is idempotent (version is not bumped, only contentSyncedAt is updated). If content changed, patch version is bumped (X.Y.Z → X.Y.Z+1). First write sets version to '1.0.0'. If createIfMissing=true, auto-creates a placeholder skill row if it does not exist yet. Throws if the skill does not exist and createIfMissing is not set. Pass testContent to co-write the test corpus alongside the canonical body in the same call (stored separately as testContent/testContentHash/testContentVersion).

createIfMissing.description: Auto-create a placeholder skill row if it does not exist (default: false)

testContent.description: Optional test corpus to store alongside the canonical body. Stored as testContent/testContentHash/testContentVersion (independently versioned).

tools.name: detect_skill_drift
tools.description: Return the VR-side sha256 hash and filePath for each skill in scope. IMPORTANT: Convex queries have no filesystem access. This tool returns the VR canonical hash + stored filePath so the caller can compute disk SHA256 and compare. scope='all' (default) returns every skill. name=<slug> filters to a single skill. Also returns testHash and testContentVersion for the test corpus if present.

name.description: Skill slug — filter to a single skill

scope.description: 'all' to return every skill (default when name is omitted)

limit.description: Max rows per page — default 20, hard cap 200. Pass nextCursor from the previous response to fetch the next page.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination token from a previous response's nextCursor. Omit for the first page. Never construct this by hand — it is base64url-encoded.

fields.description: Field projection — "lite" returns compact fields only (typically 5-10× smaller payload for large list scans), "full" (default) returns the full document.
